Domine, et omnia judicia tua justa sunt,
you are just and all your judgments are just,
and all your ways are mercy,
et ne vindictam sumas de peccatis meis,
and do not take vengeance for my sins,
and do not call to mind my offenses,
For we have not obeyed your precepts,
and so we have been handed over to plundering and to captivity,
and as a disgrace before all the nations,
et in improperium omnibus nationibus in quibus dispersisti nos.
among which you have dispersed us.
quia non egimus secundum præcepta tua,
For we have not acted according to your precepts,
et non ambulavimus sinceriter coram te.
and we have not walked sincerely before you.
do with me according to your will,

and order my spirit to be received in peace.
expedit enim mihi mori magis quam vivere.
For it is more expedient for me to die, than to live.”
Eadem itaque die, contigit ut Sara filia Raguelis in Rages civitate Medorum et ipsa audiret improperium ab una ex ancillis patris sui,
And so, on the same day, it happened that Sarah, the daughter of Raguel, in Rages, a city of the Medes, also heard a reproach from one of her father’s servant maids.
For she had been given to seven husbands,
et dæmonium nomine Asmodæus occiderat eos,
and a demon named Asmodeus had killed them,
mox ut ingressi fuissent ad eam.
as soon as they had approached her.
Ergo cum pro culpa sua increparet puellam,
when she corrected the maid for her fault,
Amplius ex te non videamus filium
“May we never see son or daughter from you upon the earth,
just as you have already killed seven husbands?”
Ad hanc vocem perrexit in superius cubiculum domus suæ:
she proceeded to an upper room of her house.
And for three days and three nights,
she did not eat or drink.
sed in oratione persistens cum lacrimis deprecabatur Deum,
But, continuing in prayer with tears, she beseeched God,
ut ab isto improperio liberaret eam.
so that he would liberate her from this reproach.
And it happened on the third day,
while she was completing her prayer,
that she said: “Blessed is your name,
O God of our fathers, who,
et in tempore tribulationis peccata dimittis his qui invocant te.
And in time of tribulation, you dismiss the sins of those who call upon you.
to you, I direct my eyes.
ut de vinculo improperii hujus absolvas me,
that you may absolve me from the chains of this reproach,
aut certe desuper terram eripias me.
or at least take me away from the earth.
that I have never coveted a husband,
et mundam servavi animam meam ab omni concupiscentia.
and I have preserved my soul clean from all impure desire.
I have never mingled myself with those who play.
neque cum his qui in levitate ambulant, participem me præbui.
And I have not presented myself as a participant with those who walk with levity.
But I consented to accept a husband,
either I was unworthy of them,
aut illi forsitan me non fuerunt digni,
or they perhaps were not worthy of me.
quia forsitan viro alii conservasti me.
For perhaps you have preserved me for another husband.
Non est enim in hominis potestate consilium tuum.
For your counsel is not within the ability of man.
Hoc autem pro certo habet omnis qui te colit:
But all who worship you are certain of this:
and if it should be in tribulation,
and if it should be corrected,
shall be permitted to approach your mercy.
Non enim delectaris in perditionibus nostris:
For you are not delighted with our perdition.
For, after a storm, you create tranquility,
In illo tempore exauditæ sunt preces amborum in conspectu gloriæ summi Dei:
At that time, the prayers of them both were heard in the sight of the glory of the most high God.
et missus est angelus Domini sanctus Raphaël ut curaret eos ambos,
And the holy Angel of the Lord, Raphael, was sent to care for both of them,
quorum uno tempore sunt orationes in conspectu Domini recitatæ.
whose prayers were recited at the same time in the sight of the Lord.
